title: Agent activity file
description: The activity file of the Agent activity diagram (etalii/agent-activity-diagram), `.aad`: YAML, read and written through agent-activity-diagram.fbl#aad, and described for agents in agent-activity-diagram.md. A file this schema refuses may still open: ADP keeps keys it does not know and values it cannot read, and reports them as findings. What the schema cannot check (that a key names an element of the right type, that an id is used once) are findings of agent-activity-diagram.dis and FBL. Read a moment such as `updated` as a string: a YAML 1.1 reader that turns it into a timestamp is not reading this format.

agent-activity-diagram.description: The header: the version of this format. A file of a later version opens read-only.

view.description: The person's part of the file: the canvas switch, locked positions and folded groups. ADP creates it with the first of them and removes it with the last. Agents leave it alone.

showArchived.description: Whether specifications whose status is archived are drawn: the canvas switch, set by the person. Absent means false.

placements.description: Locked positions, one per locked element; an element without one is placed by the layout.

groups.description: Groups whose collapse state differs from their default, one entry per element and group.

Id.description: A ShortGuid (25 characters of base 36) as ADP writes them, or any id written by hand, such as s-knowledge; unique across the whole file.

Link.description: An http or https address, or a path: absolute, or relative to the activity file's folder. Any other link is kept and reported, and never opened.

Moment.description: ISO 8601 with its offset, such as 2026-10-08T23:44:00+02:00.

Project.description: One body of work, such as a repository or a product.

Specification.description: One piece of specified work in a project.

project.description: The id of the project it belongs to.

tasks.description: Left out when there is none; never written as [].

Task.description: A task of a specification. Listed in its specification under its status, most recently updated first.

updated.description: When the task was last changed.

specification.description: The id of the one specification it works on.

Location.description: Where an agent's work is: a branch, and a folder.

agent.description: The id of the agent whose work this is.

environment.description: The id of the environment it is on.

folder.description: The worktree's folder; left out, or Default, for the repository's main checkout.

pullRequests.description: Left out when there is none; never written as [].

PullRequest.description: A pull request opened from a location.

updated.description: When the pull request was last changed.

Environment.description: A system the work happens on.

GroupState.description: A group's state where it differs from its default. The group is a task status as written, or pullRequests for a location's pull requests.
